definitions.explanation: The quality of being morally right, logically justified, or socially acceptable. Often used when questioning or asserting whether an action, decision, or claim is properly grounded.

examples.japanese: {正当性|せいとうせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{主張|しゅちょう}する→主張する：25380_shuchousuru⟧。
⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{決定|けってい}→決定：02701_kettei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{正当性|せいとうせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{問|と}われている→問う：02299_tou⟧。
examples.english: The legitimacy of that decision is being questioned.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{正当性|せいとうせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{信|しん}じている→信じる：01111_shinjiru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦こそ→こそ：12731_koso⟧、⟦{強|つよ}く→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧⟦{主張|しゅちょう}できる→主張する：25380_shuchousuru⟧。
examples.english: It is precisely because you believe your actions are justified that you can argue your case confidently.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{正当|せいとう}→正当：13191_seitou⟧ (legitimate, justified) + ⟦{性|せい}→性：09880_sei⟧ (-ness). Used in formal and academic discourse to discuss whether actions or claims are morally or logically sound.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {正当性|せいとうせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{問|と}う→問う：02299_tou⟧ — to question the legitimacy of
- {正当性|せいとうせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{証明|しょうめい}する→証明する：17851_shoumeisuru⟧ — to prove justification
- {正当性|せいとうせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{欠|か}く→欠く：13166_kaku⟧ — to lack legitimacy

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{妥当性|だとうせい}→妥当性：05806_datousei⟧: validity, reasonableness (whether something is sensible/appropriate)
- {合法性|ごうほうせい}: legality (whether something is permitted by law)
- {正統性|せいとうせい}: legitimate succession (same pronunciation; refers to rightful authority by lineage or tradition)
